title: Josiah describes author Max Davis's popping house and nearby barn

tellings.quote: are you a barn man Max like there's animals or there's a Farm by you

plain: A boy named Josiah is said to have described the house of an author, Max Davis, with its popping noises, and a barn nearby, without being told about them. His mother tells it as someone who was there, and she recalls Josiah asking: "are you a barn man Max, like there's animals or there's a farm by you". She tells it on an episode about the Telepathy Tapes, a documentary on children said to read minds, as a sign that her son picked up details he had no ordinary way to know.
